doc.summary: A folder of CSV order exports to public.orders, upserted by the order number; amounts rounded to 2, local Berlin times to UTC

from.what: a folder (or an SFTP folder) the old system exports orders into, one CSV file per export

EXPORT_DIR.description: the folder the old system's CSV exports are in

SOURCE_TZ.description: the zone the old system wrote its times in

yaml:
schema: theprotocol.migration/v1
name: csv-to-postgres
title: "Order exports (CSV files) to PostgreSQL"
summary: "A folder of CSV order exports to public.orders, upserted by the order number; amounts rounded to 2, local Berlin times to UTC"
from:
  kind: file
  what: "a folder (or an SFTP folder) the old system exports orders into, one CSV file per export"
to:
  kind: sql
  engines: [postgresql]
  what: public.orders
parameters:
  EXPORT_DIR:
    description: "the folder the old system's CSV exports are in"
    default: export
  SOURCE_TZ:
    description: "the zone the old system wrote its times in"
    default: Europe/Berlin
  TARGET_ENGINE:
    description: "postgresql; sqlite writes a local file instead, to rehearse"
    default: postgresql
    enum: [postgresql, sqlite]
  TARGET_HOST:
    description: "the new database server"
    default: localhost
  TARGET_PORT:
    description: "its port"
    default: "5432"
  TARGET_DATABASE:
    description: "the new database"
    default: app
  TARGET_USER:
    description: "a login limited to the target table"
    default: tp_migrate
  TARGET_PASSWORD:
    description: "its password, as a reference such as env:TARGET_DB_PASSWORD"
    secret: true
  TARGET_PATH:
    description: "TARGET_ENGINE sqlite only: the rehearsal file"
    default: target.db
  TARGET_TABLE:
    description: "the new table"
    default: public.orders
load:
  mappings: [orders]
  batch_rows: 1000
reconcile:
  - mapping: orders
    source:
      key: [order_no]
      fields: [ordered_at, amount, customer_id]
    target:
      key: [order_no]
      fields: [ordered_at, amount, customer_id]
    pairs:
      ordered_at: ordered_at
      amount: amount
      customer_id: customer_id
sample:
  exports:
    file: sample/orders.csv
    format: csv
cutover:
  checklist:
    - "Stop the old system's exports (or let the last one land)"
    - "Load again (only new rows move)"
    - "Reconcile again"
    - "Point the readers at the new table"
rollback: auto

name: csv-to-postgres proxy.yaml
yaml:
version: 1
name: csv-to-postgres
sources:
  exports:
    type: filedrop
    config:
      path: "${EXPORT_DIR}"
      format: csv
      suffix: ".csv"
      id_field: order_no
      settle_seconds: 0
      poll_seconds: 0
sinks:
  shop:
    type: sql_upsert
    config:
      engine: "${TARGET_ENGINE}"
      host: "${TARGET_HOST}"
      connect_args:
        port: "${TARGET_PORT}"
      database: "${TARGET_DATABASE}"
      user: "${TARGET_USER}"
      password: "${TARGET_PASSWORD}"
      path: "${TARGET_PATH}"
      table: "${TARGET_TABLE}"
      key: [order_no]
      on_conflict: update
      preimage: true
mappings:
  - name: orders
    version: 1
    from: exports
    to: shop
    fields:
      order_no:
        path: "$.payload.data.order_no"
        as: int
      customer_id:
        path: "$.payload.data.customer_id"
        as: int
      ordered_at:
        path: "$.payload.data.ordered_at"
        as: datetime
        format: "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"
        tz: "${SOURCE_TZ}"
      amount:
        path: "$.payload.data.amount"
        as: decimal
        round: 2
      currency:
        path: "$.payload.data.currency"
        trim: true
        case: upper
      status:
        path: "$.payload.data.status"
        trim: true
        case: lower

yaml:
schema: theprotocol.migration/v1
name: sql-to-postgres
title: "Customers from an old SQL table to PostgreSQL"
summary: "One customers table to public.customers, upserted by the old id; dd.mm.yyyy dates, status codes and padded names cleaned on the way"
from:
  kind: sql
  engines: [postgresql, mysql, sqlserver, sqlite]
  what: "a customers table"
to:
  kind: sql
  engines: [postgresql]
  what: public.customers
parameters:
  SOURCE_ENGINE:
    description: "the old database's engine"
    default: sqlite
    enum: [postgresql, mysql, sqlserver, sqlite]
  SOURCE_PATH:
    description: "sqlite only: the old database file"
    default: legacy.db
  SOURCE_HOST:
    description: "the old database server (all but sqlite)"
    default: localhost
  SOURCE_DATABASE:
    description: "the old database (all but sqlite)"
    default: legacy
  SOURCE_USER:
    description: "a login that may only read the customers table"
    default: tp_readonly
  SOURCE_PASSWORD:
    description: "its password, as a reference such as env:LEGACY_DB_PASSWORD"
    secret: true
  SOURCE_TABLE:
    description: "the old table"
    default: customers
  TARGET_ENGINE:
    description: "postgresql; sqlite writes a local file instead, to rehearse"
    default: postgresql
    enum: [postgresql, sqlite]
  TARGET_HOST:
    description: "the new database server"
    default: localhost
  TARGET_PORT:
    description: "its port"
    default: "5432"
  TARGET_DATABASE:
    description: "the new database"
    default: app
  TARGET_USER:
    description: "a login limited to the target table"
    default: tp_migrate
  TARGET_PASSWORD:
    description: "its password, as a reference such as env:TARGET_DB_PASSWORD"
    secret: true
  TARGET_PATH:
    description: "TARGET_ENGINE sqlite only: the rehearsal file"
    default: target.db
  TARGET_TABLE:
    description: "the new table"
    default: public.customers
load:
  mappings: [customers]
  batch_rows: 1000
reconcile:
  - mapping: customers
    source:
      key: [id]
      fields: [name, signup_date, status]
    target:
      key: [legacy_id]
      fields: [full_name, signed_up, status]
    pairs:
      name: full_name
      signup_date: signed_up
      status: status
sample:
  legacy:
    file: sample/customers.jsonl
    format: jsonl
cutover:
  checklist:
    - "Stop writes to the old system"
    - "Load again (only changes move)"
    - "Reconcile again"
    - "Point the readers at the new system"
rollback: auto
workflow:
  - key: dry-run
    role: migration.runner
    acceptance: "a dry-run report whose verdict is pass"
    budget_share: 40
  - key: reconcile
    role: migration.reconciler
    input_from: dry-run
    acceptance: "a reconcile report whose verdict is pass"
    budget_share: 60

name: sql-to-postgres proxy.yaml
yaml:
version: 1
name: sql-to-postgres
sources:
  legacy:
    type: sqlpoll
    config:
      engine: "${SOURCE_ENGINE}"
      path: "${SOURCE_PATH}"
      host: "${SOURCE_HOST}"
      database: "${SOURCE_DATABASE}"
      user: "${SOURCE_USER}"
      password: "${SOURCE_PASSWORD}"
      table: "${SOURCE_TABLE}"
      cursor: id
      poll_seconds: 0
sinks:
  crm:
    type: sql_upsert
    config:
      engine: "${TARGET_ENGINE}"
      host: "${TARGET_HOST}"
      connect_args:
        port: "${TARGET_PORT}"
      database: "${TARGET_DATABASE}"
      user: "${TARGET_USER}"
      password: "${TARGET_PASSWORD}"
      path: "${TARGET_PATH}"
      table: "${TARGET_TABLE}"
      key: [legacy_id]
      on_conflict: update
      preimage: true
mappings:
  - name: customers
    version: 1
    from: legacy
    to: crm
    fields:
      legacy_id: "$.payload.id"
      full_name:
        path: "$.payload.name"
        trim: true
      email:
        path: "$.payload.email"
        required: false
        trim: true
        case: lower
      signed_up:
        path: "$.payload.signup_date"
        as: date
        format: "%d.%m.%Y"
      status:
        path: "$.payload.status"
        trim: true
        case: upper
        map:
          A: active
          I: inactive
          B: blocked

doc.name: sql-to-rest
doc.title: Products from an old SQL table to a REST API
doc.summary: One products table to POST /products, one request per product, the record key as Idempotency-Key; prices from text, flags to booleans

to.what: a products API: POST /products, and GET /products for the read-back

SOURCE_PATH.description: sqlite only: the old database file

SOURCE_HOST.description: the old database server (all but sqlite)

SOURCE_USER.description: a login that may only read the products table

SOURCE_PASSWORD.description: its password, as a reference such as env:LEGACY_DB_PASSWORD

PRODUCTS_TOKEN.description: the API's bearer token, as a reference such as env:PRODUCTS_API_TOKEN

checklist: Stop writes to the old table
Point the shop at the API

yaml:
schema: theprotocol.migration/v1
name: sql-to-rest
title: "Products from an old SQL table to a REST API"
summary: "One products table to POST /products, one request per product, the record key as Idempotency-Key; prices from text, flags to booleans"
from:
  kind: sql
  engines: [postgresql, mysql, sqlserver, sqlite]
  what: "a products table"
to:
  kind: rest
  what: "a products API: POST /products, and GET /products for the read-back"
parameters:
  SOURCE_ENGINE:
    description: "the old database's engine"
    default: sqlite
    enum: [postgresql, mysql, sqlserver, sqlite]
  SOURCE_PATH:
    description: "sqlite only: the old database file"
    default: legacy.db
  SOURCE_HOST:
    description: "the old database server (all but sqlite)"
    default: localhost
  SOURCE_DATABASE:
    description: "the old database (all but sqlite)"
    default: legacy
  SOURCE_USER:
    description: "a login that may only read the products table"
    default: tp_readonly
  SOURCE_PASSWORD:
    description: "its password, as a reference such as env:LEGACY_DB_PASSWORD"
    secret: true
  SOURCE_TABLE:
    description: "the old table"
    default: products
  PRODUCTS_URL:
    description: "where each product is POSTed"
    default: "http://127.0.0.1:8765/products"
  PRODUCTS_TOKEN:
    description: "the API's bearer token, as a reference such as env:PRODUCTS_API_TOKEN"
    secret: true
load:
  mappings: [products]
  batch_rows: 1000
reconcile:
  - mapping: products
    source:
      key: [id]
      fields: [name, price_text, active]
    target:
      key: [id]
      fields: [name, price, active]
      read:
        url: "${PRODUCTS_URL}"
        items_path: "$.items"
    pairs:
      name: name
      price_text: price
      active: active
sample:
  legacy:
    file: sample/products.jsonl
    format: jsonl
cutover:
  checklist:
    - "Stop writes to the old table"
    - "Load again (only changes move)"
    - "Reconcile again"
    - "Point the shop at the API"
rollback: manual

name: sql-to-rest proxy.yaml
yaml:
version: 1
name: sql-to-rest
sources:
  legacy:
    type: sqlpoll
    config:
      engine: "${SOURCE_ENGINE}"
      path: "${SOURCE_PATH}"
      host: "${SOURCE_HOST}"
      database: "${SOURCE_DATABASE}"
      user: "${SOURCE_USER}"
      password: "${SOURCE_PASSWORD}"
      table: "${SOURCE_TABLE}"
      cursor: id
      poll_seconds: 0
sinks:
  catalog:
    type: rest
    config:
      url: "${PRODUCTS_URL}"
      method: POST
      bearer: "${PRODUCTS_TOKEN}"
mappings:
  - name: products
    version: 1
    from: legacy
    to: catalog
    fields:
      id:
        path: "$.payload.id"
        as: int
      sku:
        path: "$.payload.sku"
        trim: true
        case: upper
      name:
        path: "$.payload.name"
        trim: true
      price:
        path: "$.payload.price_text"
        as: decimal
        round: 2
      active:
        path: "$.payload.active"
        as: bool
